scope: Targeted disease-label consistency review of visible public records having Non-Cancer, a parenthetical non-cancer label, or Healthy Subject; not an exhaustive discovery of all unlabeled non-cancer cohorts.
authority: User-confirmed Non-Cancer grouping policy; recommendations only. No WordPress changes applied.
limitations: Reviewed published narratives and current dataset-level labels; did not inspect participant-level clinical files or payloads.
Specific proposed new terms still require NCIt verification and current WordPress registry review.
Existing labels alone are not independent diagnosis evidence.
